reviews.title: Scam!
reviews.text:
Picsart’s AI agents are absolutely terrible. They create an entire video scene by scene, allowing you to review and approve each individual scene. But once everything is approved and put together, the final video glitches and has all sorts of issues.

And here’s the worst part: when you report the glitches, you’re expected to spend even more credits to fix problems caused by their own AI in the first place!

On top of that, their AI agents charge significantly more credits than the prices advertised on their website.

Their customer service is just as disappointing. When I contacted Picsart about the issue, all I got was an apology and advice to contact Apple for a refund. When I contacted Apple, they directed me straight back to Picsart.

So basically, you’re left going round in circles, paying more money to fix problems you didn’t create.

Honestly, I would strongly recommend staying away from Picsart if you’re looking for AI video production. There are better alternatives out there. Save your money and avoid the headache!

reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Experience – $83 Refund Denied Despite Immediate Request
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with Picsart and my overall experience.

I signed up for a free trial, which automatically turned into an annual subscription costing $83. As soon as I noticed the charge, I immediately requested a refund on the same day.

I never used any Premium features or services, but my refund request was rejected twice by Apple.

I find this experience very frustrating and disappointing. $83 is a significant amount of money, and I do not believe customers should feel helpless when trying to resolve an issue like this. Apple redirects me to Picsart, and Picsart redirects me back to Apple. Both companies keep referring me to each other, and neither is willing to take responsibility or help me resolve my $83 refund issue. I am stuck between the two companies with no solution, despite requesting a refund on the same day I was charged.

I hope Picsart takes customer complaints seriously and helps resolve situations like mine. I would not recommend this experience to others unless customer support and refund assistance improve.

reviews.title: Terrible Customer Support – Refund Refused
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience with Picsart. My annual subscription automatically renewed on August 26, charging me AED 332.09. I requested a refund immediately on the same day because I had no intention of renewing for another year.

Apple rejected my refund request and advised me to contact Picsart, explaining that the refund had been declined on the developer’s side.

However, Picsart’s customer support repeatedly responded with the same generic message, claiming they have no authority to issue refunds and directing me back to Apple.

I’ve contacted both companies multiple times over nearly two months, and neither has provided a solution. Instead of investigating my case or offering meaningful assistance, Picsart continues sending identical responses.

I’m extremely disappointed with the lack of accountability and customer care. I expected much better from a paid subscription service.

I would strongly recommend being cautious with annual subscriptions and automatic renewals. I am still waiting for a proper resolution and a refund.

reviews.title: So incredibly disappointing.
reviews.text: What used to be a half decent app for doing small photo edits has now decided to start forcing everyone to log in, no reason I can see as to why that would actually be necessary as it never was in the past decade or so, oh, other than to sell even more of your data to advertisers for every little penny, not only that they’ve decided to start shoving in obtuse ai features that almost nobody wants, much less supports, into what is at least supposed to a photo editing app, another thing too, this has been an issue for ages but is still a horrible policy worth mentioning, any photos or art you create in the app gives them a license to use your photos for free for whatever they’d like. Fun. The phrase all good things must come to an end comes to mind.

reviews.title: Doesn’t load my gallery
reviews.text: I do love this app and how simple it is to use. I used to use it a lot years ago and recently I downloaded it again to create collages so I can print them out. Almost 95% of the time it doesn’t load my gallery and I have to exit out of the app multiple times and go back in and try again and then sometimes if the gallery does upload the most recent screenshots or photos don’t show up. Which means I have to try over and over again exiting out of the app and going back in to see if it will show up and then it’ll be stuck in a loop of not loading my gallery again. 5% of the time maybe it’ll load the second or third try but that’s very rare experience for me and it’s very upsetting and annoying because you would expect an app like this to load your photos more expeditiously. It feels like I’m working with an old piece of technology every time I’m spending up to 20 minutes to finally get my photos to load. I haven’t found another app yet that does what I want like Picsart does it so therefore I tolerate it but it’s literally the most annoying thing ever. If I do find another app, I will most likely leave Picsart unless they fix this issue.
